items.t: Electrical problems after rain from water in the fuse panel
items.job: Clear body drains, seal the leak and clean or replace the wet fuse panel/junction box
items.note: Owners report paying about $259 to $500 for partial fixes; one dealer quoted about $1,000 in parts for the junction box.

items.t: Broken exhaust manifold bolts cause a ticking noise
items.job: Extract broken bolts and replace exhaust manifold gaskets and bolts
items.note: Seized bolts that must be drilled out add labor.

items.t: Dropped valve seat on the 4.7L V8
items.job: Rebuild or replace the affected cylinder head
items.note: If the piston or valves are damaged, a used or remanufactured engine may make more sense.

items.t: Hemi lifter or camshaft failure causing a tick or rattle
items.note: One 2009 owner was quoted about $3,300 for lifters with possible camshaft work.

items.t: Engine stalls from a failing camshaft position sensor
items.job: Replace camshaft position sensor (and crank sensor if suspect)

items.t: Steering jerks or wanders over bumps
items.job: Replace worn ball joints/steering parts and align
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $1,500 for this complaint.

items.t: Rear axle bearing howl or failure
items.job: Replace rear axle bearings or overhaul the rear axle
items.note: Owners report bills from about $1,150 to over $2,500 when the whole rear end was rebuilt.

items.t: Rear axle pinion nut can loosen (recall 13V-038)
items.job: Recall repair of the rear axle pinion nut
items.note: Free at a Chrysler/Dodge dealer if not already done. Check your VIN on nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.job: Replace front airbag inflators under recall
items.note: Free at a Chrysler/Dodge dealer if not already done. Check your VIN on nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.job: Recall replacement of the right steering knuckle
items.note: Free at a Chrysler/Dodge dealer if not already done. Check your VIN on nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: "No Bus" message, gauges sweep and engine won't crank
items.job: Diagnose data network fault and repair wiring or replace the failed module
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $1,300.

items.t: Battery drains and the engine won't start
items.job: Find the battery drain and replace the faulty module
items.note: One owner was quoted about $1,600 for a front module.

items.job: Free up or replace the liftgate latch
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $200.

items.t: Valve cover gasket oil leaks on the 4.7L
Coolant leaks and overheating on the 4.7L
items.job: Replace failed cooling part (water pump, hose, radiator or fan clutch)
